plan.title: Bulk Counter Offer Disabled on Live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer's Responses tab.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu containing Send Bulk Counter Offer.
Assert the bulk counter-offer action is present but greyed out.
Assert hovering the disabled item shows the product's explanation tooltip.
Try the disabled action and verify that it opens nothing or changes nothing.
